Define a box style

Source: R/style.R
box_style.Rd

Fill, border and spacing for [bb_box()] (and the label of [bb_placeholder()]). Padding sits inside the border, margin outside it. Lengths are `grid::unit` or inches, with 1, 2 (vertical, horizontal) or 4 (top, right, bottom, left) values.

Usage

box_style(
  fill = NA,
  border = NULL,
  radius = 0,
  padding = 0,
  margin = 0,
  margin_fill = NA
)

box_style_panel(fill = "panel", padding = c(12, 14, 12, 14)/96, ...)

Arguments

fill

Fill: a colour (theme names allowed), [gradient_fill()], [stripe_fill()], or `NA`.

border

A [line_style()] or a colour for the border; `NULL`/`NA` for none.

radius

Corner radius.

padding

Space between the border and the content.

margin

Space outside the border.

margin_fill

Fill colour of the margin band.

...

For `box_style_panel()`, further [box_style()] arguments.

Value

A `bb_box_style` object.

Details

`box_style_panel()` is the flat note panel: theme `panel` fill, no border, square corners, 12/14px padding.

Examples

box_style(fill = "panel", padding = unit(c(6, 8), "pt"))
#> $fill
#> [1] "panel"
#> 
#> $border
#> NULL
#> 
#> $radius
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $padding
#> [1] 0.083022 0.110696 0.083022 0.110696
#> 
#> $margin
#> [1] 0 0 0 0
#> 
#> $margin_fill
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bb_box_style"
